name: architect-skills
description: 18 Claude Code skills for building architecture: design theory, concept design, programming, typology, spatial planning, envelope, structural systems, MEP, daylighting, materials, building codes, accessibility, fire safety, acoustics, sustainability, and construction documentation. Draws from 50+ architects and standards including IBC, ASHRAE, ADA, NFPA, Passive House, LEED, BREEAM, and WELL. Includes 7 Python calculators.
